name: Slider
description: Chooses a number, or a range with one thumb per value, along a track.

label.description: Visible label text. A slider needs a label, aria-label or aria-labelledby; there is no fallback name.

helperText.description: Helper text shown below the slider

invalid.description: Whether the value fails validation. The track takes the danger edge and errorMessage shows under it with an icon.

errorMessage.description: Message shown under the slider while invalid is true

value.description: Controlled value: a number, or an array for a range (one thumb per value)

onValueChange.description: Called with the new value while the user moves a thumb: (value: number | number[]) => void

onValueCommitted.description: Called with the value when the user finishes an interaction

largeStep.description: Larger step for Page Up/Page Down and shift-arrow keys

showValue.description: Show the formatted value beside the label

showValueOnDrag.description: Show the formatted value in a bubble above the thumb while dragging

format.description: Number formatting for the shown value, the bubble and the announced value

locale.description: Locale for format; defaults to the runtime locale

size.description: Height of the control strip, so a slider lines up with fields of the same size. The track and thumb keep one size.

readOnly.description: Show the value without letting the user change it

name.description: Name of the hidden input for form submission

form.description: ID of the form that owns the hidden input

thumbAlignment.description: How the thumb aligns at the minimum and maximum edges

getAriaLabel.description: Accessible name for each thumb of a range, by index: (index: number) => string

aria-label.description: Accessible label when the visible label is omitted

when: Any value along a range, where roughly right is good enough
The effect is visible as the user drags
whenNot: An exact number matters (use Input type="number")
A handful of fixed choices (use RadioGroup or Select)
A value the user cannot change here (show it as text, or set readOnly when it sits among editable fields)
guidelines: Turn on showValue whenever the number matters, and format it with Intl options instead of a string suffix
Set min and max to the real limits, not 0-100 by habit
Pick a step the user can actually land on
Give each thumb of a range its own name with getAriaLabel
accessibility: The visible label names every thumb; a range names each thumb with getAriaLabel
Arrow keys move the thumb; Page Up and Page Down move by largeStep
An invalid slider shows an icon and words, wired to the thumb with aria-describedby
A read-only slider says so with aria-readonly

propsSummary: value: number | number[] - controlled value (an array is a range)
helperText: string - helper text below slider
invalid: boolean - fails validation; errorMessage: ReactNode - shown with an icon
readOnly: boolean - shows the value, refuses changes
showValueOnDrag: boolean - show value bubble during drag
getAriaLabel: (index) => string - per-thumb names for a range
